findings.observation: West extreme of the canton AOI lies outside the WorldPop raster extent (window all NoData); 0.94 km2 of cantons area has no population cells at all.

WorldPop has 245 NoData patches inside the cantons (largest 961 cells near 6.10-6.15E 50.02-50.08N; Clervaux has 3494 NoData cells). 01_pop_lux valid cells equal exactly source-valid AND cell-centre-inside-cantons (456764), so the clip keeps source NoData as NoData and does not fill it.
All six rasters (input, 01..04 intermediates, final) share one grid: pixel offsets (0,0), 940x880 cells of 0.000833 deg (~60 x 93 m at centre, not the documented 100 m). No misaligned second grid.

metric.name: landuse_area_outside_aoi_km2

findings.observation: 16 of 3879 OSM landuse polygons do not touch the cantons (12 industrial, 4 residential); 5.87 km2 of landuse lies outside Luxembourg. Residential polygons outside are still rasterized into 02_res_mask but fall on NoData population, so 02_res_mask has 54381 cells while 03_pop_res has 52415 valid.

02_res_mask uses 0 as NoData (non-residential cells are NoData, not 0), so 03_pop_res is NoData (-3.4e38) off residential cells; 04_factor uses nodata 0 and covers 465943 cells (cell-centre rasterize, no all-touched); final exposure sum is 1.0418e11 EUR over 52415 cells.
